offer.text: Things are... serious now, aren't they? Then it's time you met my family properly. Bring a cake to share at the table — make a good impression, and so will I.

accept.text: Don't be nervous. They'll adore you. Probably.

decline.text: ...You're not having second thoughts, are you?

in_progress.text: Have you got the cake? They're expecting us.

ready.text: A whole cake! Oh, they'll be charmed before you say a word.

complete.text: They loved you — I knew they would. It feels right, you and me. It really does.
